eoe.text: The Seriema is the battered spacecraft where Sami wakes under fusion thrust with fuzzy memory, after Mirri weftwalks away and vanishes and Sami becomes determined to find her.

Haliya appears in its cockpit and offers herself as a hostage after a Hopelight lasers off the main drive nozzle, and she urges Vondam to stop killing the Kav, but Vondam refuses to destroy the ship and wants the object retrieved in stasis.
The Seriema then lunges up into space, and the Guns' boost beams push its mirrored sail out across the Mordraine Ring into interplanetary space.

Aboard it, Sami announces that the Metalman has arrived and prefers the name Tezzeret, who enters the ship from his black engineless ship and says he arranged events so the stone would choose him as its conduit.
Tezzeret plans to sell the Endstone to its maker, using Mm'menon's ship to boost the Seriema to Infinite Guideline, and Sami threatens to blow up the ship rather than let him harm Haliya.
